scientific_question: Can the paper-consistent LWT compromise replace c_fc in all layers and c_proj only in the final two transformer layers while remaining within 0.005 validation CE of the accepted c_fc-only parent at 124M/5TPP?

theory.paper_mechanism: LWT assigns distinct latent maps by layer because layer parameter manifolds need not share one chart. The accepted layers-8-11 run is direct transformer evidence for this allocation principle.
theory.why_tail_two: The only accepted c_proj intervention is the jointly trained terminal band 8-11. Narrowing that contiguous band to the final two layers is fixed ex ante by downstream path length: layers 10-11 have the fewest subsequent nonlinear and residual transformations through which c_proj error can compound.
theory.why_not_another_chart: Exact optimizer-state transport, static modulation, paper-style elementwise activation, quadratic charts, learned low-rank residual state, and fixed local/global orthogonal maps all failed preregistered representability or causal gates. The chart, optimizer, feedback decay, and attention/c_fc parents are frozen here.
theory.coadaptation_constraint: Dense-parent phase replay was shown invalid even for the independently accepted late band. This mask therefore requires one jointly trained from-scratch causal test; no post-hoc tensor transplantation or endpoint oracle can decide it.
theory.compression_scope: The candidate procedurally generates two of twelve c_proj matrices. At each selected layer, 147456 procedural coordinates stand in for a 768x3072 target matrix, a 6.25 percent coordinate ratio. The current PyTorch implementation still materializes dense weights and does not claim registered-parameter, memory, or inference-FLOP reduction.
theory.single_boundary_test: This is one Pareto-boundary point, not a layer sweep. It tests whether any nontrivial c_proj replacement survives a strict loss budget after the four-layer band missed that budget by 0.006066 CE.

candidate.c_fc: unchanged accepted directed-product schedule [22,22,22,22,22,22], radius 1.0, error-feedback decay 1.0 in all twelve layers
candidate.procedural_c_proj: unchanged hidden64 plus residual24 Muon-matched Givens, output32, neighbors64, error-feedback decay 0.5
candidate.training_gauge: All parameters initialize and co-adapt in one run; no checkpoint transplant or warm start.
candidate.inference: Generated c_proj matrices are materialized as ordinary dense GEMM weights; no new inference operation is added.
forbidden_changes: different learning rate, optimizer, schedule, seed, data, or fixed evaluation window
learned basis, LoRA, dense residual adapter, HyperConnection, activation, gain, shear, or modulation
post-result threshold change, layer-mask sweep, automatic retry, or larger rung

decision_rule.pass: Accept tail-two c_proj LWT as the strict-loss partial-MLP Pareto point. It does not authorize another mask, a full-c_proj claim, or a larger rung.
decision_rule.fail: Close c_proj replacement at the <=0.005 CE budget with the current chart. Retain c_fc-only as the accepted MLP structure and do not sweep individual layers or chart variants.

performance_gate.mode: foreground exact scientific config with one warmup and eight timed real updates; direct polling without a watchdog

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify terminal state and exact artifacts against the active project note; seal fixed losses, tail-two mask identity, optimizer ownership, MFU, provenance, checkpoint and hashes; compare against c_fc-only and late-four controls; then continue the MLP research plan autonomously
